# Strange Attractor

> Strange Attractor creates an economy where professionals don't just use AI, they own AI — turning their expertise into income-generating AI agents.

Strange Attractor (strange-attractor.com) is an AI company. Its website is an
interactive art piece: a field of handwritten digits surrounding an animated
strange attractor — a nod to chaotic systems, where rare initial conditions
give rise to intricate, never-repeating patterns.

## Mission

At Strange Attractor, we want to create an economy where professionals don't
just use AI, they own AI; turning their expertise into income-generating AI
agents.

## Projects

- [YouSquared](https://yousquared.ai): the first project built at Strange Attractor.
